frozenSources.support: 17. A Formula That Will Work Wonders for You
Make perspective-taking concrete by showing how motives become legible when you ask what the other person thinks they are protecting or pursuing.

conceptFocus: ask what the other person thinks they are protecting
ask what the other person thinks they are pursuing
keep empathy specific rather than sentimental
guardrails: keep the move strategic and concrete
do not confuse understanding with agreement
